Introducing Whop CLI: Run your business agentically

Everything you can do from your Whop dashboard can be run from a terminal. Build a business, create products, set pricing, run ads, move money, and more. Run it yourself, or hand it to an AI agent.

Key takeaways

 The Whop CLI makes your entire business programmable by exposing Whop's end-to-end API through a terminal. [...] Terminal

```
whop --llms # hand an AI the full list of commands whop mcp add # connect the CLI to your AI assistant (e.g. Claude) whop skills add # give your agent ready-made skills
```

This means you never have to touch the terminal yourself – your agent simply runs commands through it, on your behalf. Creating a product? Just tell your assistant 'create a $20 product and send me the checkout link'.

And you can always see what your agent did. Every action is logged.

It's that easy.

## Run Whop from your terminal today

Whatever you're creating, Whop's CLI has you covered.

For macOS and Linux, the install command is simple:

Terminal

```
curl -fsSL  | sh
``` [...] Terminal

```
curl -fsSL  | sh
```

On other platforms, you can install via npm (requires Node.js 22 or later). Check out our docs linked below for details on how to install, test, and get started.

results.title: Whop releases command-line interface to let business owners and their AI agents access digital commerce - SiliconANGLE
results.content:
A CLI is a method for accessing and managing software from the terminal. To the everyday user, this differs from the graphical user interface, which includes double-clicking and drag-and-drop, in that it is where users access the operating system and tools using text. Users and developers type specific commands, hit enter, and the computer responds in text as it takes actions.

Business users can now run wide swaths of their ecommerce operations through the command line. This includes launching products, spinning up ad campaigns, checking sales stats, managing subscriptions and moving money. [...] “Whop CLI [connects] businesses with our end-to-end API,” said Schwartz. “Whether you’re a developer or someone who’s never written a line of code in your life, you now have the same access to the full power of Whop.”

Not only can users access this text interface, but now AI agents can easily control business operations. Agents can quickly and easily set up business operations and patterns in moments, without requiring users to type a line of code.

Access to this command-line interface is part of an evolution for Whop as the company continues to build out access to the platform’s infrastructure. This builds on the company’s recent release of Whop Cards and an ad platform. [...] The company’s API allows developers to plug Whop’s capabilities into their apps, for example, building payment flows, managing users running ads and more.

“Businesses use Whop to help them grow faster, and the fact that many of them don’t have a dedicated engineering team to scale and build has been a major roadblock,” said co-founder and Chief Executive Steven Schwartz.

Building these experiences into an app and accessing an API meant requiring a level of technical or coding expertise. With the release of the CLI today, users can run simple commands that business owners and AI agent tools can understand. Now, business owners can hook in and get a live product running with a checkout link simply by chatting with their favorite AI agent.

results.title: Whop Launches Command-Line Interface, Bringing Full Stack API Access to Every Business Owner-And Their AI Agent Armies
results.content:
Business owners can now run wide swaths of their operations with Whop CLI: launching products and setting prices, spinning up ad campaigns, checking sales stats, and moving money. It extends Whop's infrastructure to the API layer, giving every business owner on the platform a full toolkit, which once took entire teams to operate. Their agent can use the CLI to evolve the business in seconds, without needing to write a single line of code. Whop CLI meets entrepreneurs where they are, combining the power of Whop's API with the accessibility of natural language to make the platform's most powerful features available to anyone building a business. [...] Whop CLI is the latest product from Whop, adding to the platform's infrastructure enabling anyone, anywhere, to launch a business. It builds on Whop's recent Whop Cards and Whop Ads launch, and API growing partnerships with Replit, Poke, Cal.com and more, further empowering the next generation of entrepreneurs.

Whop CLI is available now to Whop users with an active account. To learn more about Whop CLI visit LINK. [...] NEW YORK, July 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Whop, the company building the first end-to-end API for running a business, today announced the launch of Whop CLI (Command-Line Interface), a new product that gives any business owner on Whop easy access to the platform's full API, whether they operate it themselves or collaborate with an AI agent. Whop CLI equips users with a clear, simple language approach to Whop's full suite of business tools, making capabilities previously available only to developers accessible to every entrepreneur.
